rule: A type variable resolves to its declared bound (C++: a concept that pins one type, `std::same_as<T>` / `derived_from<T>`; otherwise unconstrained, stays low). | Generic/template type arguments are dropped from every ID (`HashSet#<init>`). | Body-less member declarations of scanned types are defined in the scan (high)
notes: x has type parameter T whose declared bound is Namer (in the scan, method declared without body: high) or fmt.Stringer (outside the scan: medium). Label and Show are never instantiated, so no concrete type flows into x and there are no VTA low edges. Type arguments do not appear in IDs (Label, not Label[T]).
